articles.title: Here are all the ways Apple is raising prices and why
articles.summary: Apple’s hardware price increases in June were costly and unwelcome. They were also just the start of a wave of higher prices on Apple products and services. Over the last few weeks, Apple has been raising prices in all areas for different reasons.
articles.title_zh: Apple 調漲價格的所有方式及原因
articles.summary_zh: Apple 在六月份的硬體價格上漲令人失望，但這只是 Apple 產品和服務漲價浪潮的開始。近週來，Apple 因各種原因在所有領域提高了價格。

articles.title: Is Apple One worth it for you after recent price hikes?
articles.summary: Yesterday, Apple announced price increases for Apple Music as well as two of its Apple One bundles. Apple offers a broad range of services nowadays, ranging from Apple TV to Apple Music , Apple Fitness+ , and more. Apple One lets you bundle those together at lower prices. Is Apple One worth it? Here’s what you need to know.
articles.title_zh: 近期漲價後，Apple One 對你值得購買嗎？
articles.summary_zh: Apple 宣布調漲 Apple Music 及兩項 Apple One 套餐的價格。Apple One 可將 Apple TV、Apple Music、Apple Fitness+ 等服務捆綁銷售以獲得更低價格。

articles.title: YouTube picture-in-picture (PiP) mode is broken on iPhone, Android
articles.summary: YouTube is aware of an issue on Android and iPhone where picture-in-picture (PiP) mode does not activate when closing the app.

articles.title: Indie App Spotlight: ‘Passable’ makes it easy to share your contact through Apple Wallet
articles.summary: Welcome to Indie App Spotlight . This is a weekly 9to5Mac series where we showcase the latest apps in the indie app world. If you’re a developer and would like your app featured, get in contact . If you’ve ever found yourself striking up a conversation while out and about, you may end up wanting to quickly share your contact information with another person. While Apple does offer NameDrop, it lacks granularity, and isn’t always the most reliable. Passable brings contact sharing into neat looking Apple Wallet passes, and it offers tons of granularity.

articles.summary_zh: 歡迎來到獨立應用焦點，這是 9to5Mac 每週推介獨立應用的系列文章。

articles.title: HomeKit Weekly: Hardwired Matter lighting arrives with the SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light
articles.summary: Most of your smart home lights are smaller bulbs and outlet adaptors, but the market is maturing to the point where we are seeing full hardwired fixtures that integrate natively with Apple Home (via Matter). SwitchBot just recently released the new SwitchBot RGBICWW ceiling light. It brings incredibly bright illumination and native Matter support directly to your overhead ceiling lights.

articles.title: Your personal data is for sale: here is how to take it off the internet
articles.summary: If you could go back to the early days of the internet, would you handle your privacy differently? Most of us would. We would be more cautious about the services we joined and the information we shared. Since a time machine is not an option, we have to deal with the reality of the present. Your personal data is currently available and for sale at this very moment. Right now, your phone number, email address, home address, and even your family connections are being packaged and sold to marketers, insurers, and hackers. While Apple’s privacy protections in Safari and Mail help block some tracking as you browse the web, they cannot undo years of information already scraped and spread across hundreds of broker databases. Data brokers have built a multi-billion-dollar industry by collecting you

articles.summary_zh: 如果你能回到網際網路早期，是否會以不同方式處理隱私？大多數人會更謹慎地選擇加入的服務和分享的資訊。

articles.title: iPhone 18 Pro is just two months away, but you probably shouldn’t wait for it
articles.summary: The next iPhone lineup is around the corner – and it’s going to be a different one. The base model iPhone 18 won’t be making an appearance quite yet, as that model has been shifted to a spring release schedule. This September will squarely be on the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the all new foldable iPhone . Of course, there’s one major elephant in the room: price hikes. It’s inevitable that the iPhone 18 Pro lineup will cost more, which begs the question – is buying an iPhone 17 Pro at today’s prices a good idea?
articles.title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 距離發售僅兩月，但你可能不應該等待它
articles.summary_zh: 下一代 iPhone 陣容即將推出，將會有所不同。基礎款 iPhone 18 將推遲到春季發佈，九月將聚焦於 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max 和全新型號。

articles.title: Apple Music and Apple One subscriptions get more expensive
articles.summary: Apple has increased the prices of Apple Music and Apple One subscriptions in the US and other countries. In the US, the individual Apple Music plan is up from $10.99 to $11.99, while the student and family plans now cost $6.99 (up from $5.99) and $19.99 (up from $16.99), respectively. articles.title: AI didn’t replace our security team — it multiplied it.
articles.summary: For years, the assumption in security has been straightforward: mature detection and response programs require a Security Operations Center (SOC). A team of analysts looking at a wall of monitors waiting for an alert to trigger. That model made sense when the only way to scale human judgment was to hire more humans. The honest version of the AI in the SOC The AI in security conversation is mostly vendor noise right now. Every tool promises to fix one silo of the SOC. Triage. Enrichment. Threat intel. Buy enough of them, and you’ve just rebuilt the same fragmented stack with an AI badge on each piece. articles.title_zh: AI 沒有取代我們的安全團隊——它放大了我們的團隊
articles.summary_zh: 多年來,安全領域的假設一直很直接:成熟的檢測和回應計劃需要安全運營中心(SOC)。當擴展人類判斷的唯一方式是依賴分析師團隊時,這個模式是有意義的。

articles.title: The bottleneck for AI agents isn’t the model anymore. It’s the context layer.
articles.summary: There’s a pattern I’ve watched repeat for two years. A team builds an agent, hits reliability problems, upgrades the model, sees marginal improvement, and hits the same reliability problems in a slightly different form. The diagnosis is always the same: the model wasn’t smart enough. The fix is always to try a new, smarter model. The result is always the same: still broken.  This isn’t a model problem. It never was. Andrej Karpathy figured this out months ago, and in a post on X , he noted a shift in how he was spending his AI compute: “a large fraction of my recent token throughput is going less into manipulating code, and more into manipulating knowledge.” He wasn’t running a smarter model. He was building better infrastructure:  raw so
articles.title_zh: AI agents 的瓶頸不再是模型——而是 context layer
articles.summary_zh: 在過去兩年裡,我發現了一個重複出現的模式:團隊構建 agent、遇到可靠性問題、升級模型、看到邊際改進,然後以略微不同的形式遇到相同的可靠性問題。診斷結果總是一樣的:模型不夠聰明。
